issue.title: Term range query against runtime fields to accept open ranges

labels.name: :Search/Search
labels.description: Search-related issues that do not fall into other categories

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
Range query allows to specify only one end of the range, or even none. The implementation of range query against keyword runtime fields had both ends mandatory which was an oversight.

Closes #67994
